chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
"There is no religion for one who has no taqiyyah."

key_terms.تَقِيَّةَ: taqiyyah; prudent dissimulation or precaution in situations of fear or harm
key_terms.لَهُ: for him; belonging to the person described

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith "There is no religion for one who has no taqiyyah" mean?
ai.summary: This hadith emphasizes the essential place of taqiyyah within religious life. It indicates that safeguarding oneself and the believers under conditions of danger is a foundational principle tied to the preservation and practice of religion.
